_comment: Do not hand-edit the station block — regenerate it, or the held coordinates
can silently drift from the fixture and nothing downstream will notice.

estimation.//iono: The cutoff, NOT the enable, is the load-bearing field here — the
estimation.//iono2: enable is forced on by the W6 slice anyway.  Values other than the
estimation.//iono3: cutoff are the shipped defaults, restated so an arm cannot inherit a
estimation.//sh: Field-matched SH posture (_cbq305_2f_12h_d10): degree 15, single shell,
estimation.//sh2: sun-fixed, representation-error demean + d5-keep.  trace: true is what
estimation.//sh3: opens network_vtec_sh.csv (coefficients + sigma) and the per-epoch
estimation.//sh4: network_vtec_sh_health.csv (a00 + a00 sigma + per-degree rms) — the a00
estimation.//sh5: channel of the §11 item 4 decomposition.  network_ionosphere.csv is NOT
estimation.//sh6: a substitute: it writes x_r alone and is frame-broken (CLAUDE.md).
